default.title: Culture & Heritage Exploration in Manchester
default.trip_overview: A rich cultural journey through Manchester's industrial transformation, historic libraries, world-class art collections, and vibrant culinary neighborhoods.

morning.title: Gothic Marvels on Deansgate
morning.description: Start at The John Rylands Library on Deansgate. Marvel at the cathedral-like Historic Reading Room and rare illuminated manuscripts.
morning.transport_note: Easily walkable from St Peter's Square Metrolink tram stop (6 min walk).

food_stop_lunch.name: Dishoom Manchester
food_stop_lunch.recommendation: Famous house black daal, chicken ruby, and freshly baked garlic naan.

afternoon.title: Civic Grandeur & British Fine Art
afternoon.description: Stroll down Mosley Street to Manchester Art Gallery. Explore Pre-Raphaelite masterpieces and rotating contemporary craft galleries.
afternoon.transport_note: Walk 5 minutes east across Albert Square.

food_stop_dinner.name: Hawksmoor Manchester
food_stop_dinner.recommendation: Charcoal-grilled heritage beef and sticky toffee pudding in a restored Victorian courthouse.

evening.title: Sunset Skyline Views
evening.description: Head up to Cloud 23 on the 23rd floor of Beetham Tower for evening twilight panoramas across the city skyline.

morning.title: Cradle of the Industrial Revolution
morning.description: Visit Castlefield Urban Heritage Park and the Science and Industry Museum on the site of the world's oldest surviving passenger railway terminus.

places.name: Castlefield Viaduct Sky Park
places.admission: Free booked entry via National Trust

morning.transport_note: Deansgate-Castlefield Metrolink stop is right at the viaduct entrance.

food_stop_lunch.name: The Wharf Castlefield
food_stop_lunch.recommendation: Cask ales, seasonal pies, and outdoor canal-basin terrace seating.

afternoon.title: Contemporary Arts & Modern Architecture
afternoon.description: Wander along the Irwell riverfront to the striking Aviva Studios (Factory International), Manchester's new landmark cultural center.

places.name: Aviva Studios (Factory International)
places.admission: Building free to enter; ticketed exhibitions

afternoon.transport_note: 12-minute scenic waterside stroll along Liverpool Road.

food_stop_dinner.name: Mackie Mayor
food_stop_dinner.recommendation: Wood-fired sourdough pizza, ramen bowls, craft beers, and natural wine.

evening.title: Theatre in the Round
evening.description: Experience an evening theatrical performance inside the Royal Exchange Theatre's futuristic glass module.

morning.title: Northern Quarter Bohemian Independent Gems
morning.description: Explore the maze of street art, vinyl shops, and artist workshops in the Northern Quarter. Browse independent creators at Afflecks and Manchester Craft and Design Centre.
morning.transport_note: Easily walkable across the Northern Quarter grid.

food_stop_lunch.name: Federal Cafe Bar
food_stop_lunch.address: 9 Nicholas Croft, Northern Quarter, Manchester M4 1EY
food_stop_lunch.recommendation: Corn fritters with poached eggs, acai bowls, and expertly poured flat whites.

afternoon.title: Parkland Arts & Tree-Lined Galleries
afternoon.description: Take the Oxford Road corridor south to The Whitworth. Stroll through Whitworth Park and admire British watercolours in the glass park pavilion.
afternoon.transport_note: Bus 41, 42 or 43 from Piccadilly Gardens (12 minutes).

food_stop_dinner.name: Rudy's Neapolitan Pizza (Ancoats)
food_stop_dinner.recommendation: Double-fermented dough pizza with San Marzano tomatoes and fior di latte mozzarella.

evening.title: Canal Basin Sunset Walk
evening.description: Unwind with an evening walk around New Islington Marina and Mayfield Park along the restored River Medlock.
evening.transport_note: Walk 10 minutes west back towards Manchester Piccadilly station.
